baseline_models.focus_anchor: The fronted possession construction joins الكبرياء to the paired heavens and earth.
baseline_models.mechanism: Rightful grandeur occupies the full vertical merism: what is above and overshadowing and what is below it. The verse is therefore a claim of total cosmic scope, not merely an isolated adjective of greatness.

activation_trace.role: Rightful grandeur and exaltation supply the central claim of incomparable majesty.
What rises and overshadows supplies the upper cosmic pole over which grandeur extends.
The lower realm opposite the sky supplies the matching lower pole and completes the totality.

changed_reading.before: A generic closing praise that says God is great everywhere.
changed_reading.after: An exclusive attribution of rightful grandeur across the complete upper-lower architecture of the cosmos.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The closing pair العزيز الحكيم follows the claim of cosmic grandeur.
baseline_models.mechanism: Overpowering capacity is coupled to restraint, right judgment, and accurate knowledge. The second title governs the first: the power capable of sustaining cosmic grandeur is neither blind nor arbitrary.

activation_trace.role: Overpowering and prevailing force supplies the capacity to make the cosmic claim effective.
Restraint that blocks corruption supplies an internal check and corrective direction for might.
Knowledge that reaches the right result supplies intelligent direction rather than mere force.

changed_reading.before: Two conventional divine titles appended to the main assertion.
changed_reading.after: A coupled mechanism in which irresistible capacity is directed and restrained by right-knowing judgment.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The noun الكبرياء can activate magnitude, the major share of an affair, and weight that is hard to bear.
baseline_models.mechanism: Grandeur is not only rank; it is the scale and bearing of the whole upper-lower affair. The verse can thus present the possessor of grandeur as the one adequate to the cosmos's magnitude and burden.

activation_trace.role: Magnitude against smallness supplies the immense scale of the claim.
The major portion or main charge of an affair supplies the sense of bearing the whole cosmic matter.
Great weight and difficulty supply the burden dimension of cosmic adequacy.
Elevation supplies the high extreme of the scale being borne.
The grounded lower extreme completes the span whose scale and burden are at issue.

changed_reading.after: Grandeur also names unique adequacy to the magnitude, main charge, and weight of the entire cosmic order.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same pair that closes the focus ayah identifies the source of the descending book at the opening. The ending therefore returns cosmic grandeur to the revelation that has displayed and ordered it, making the two titles a frame around the surah.

activation_trace.role: Prevailing force characterizes the source of the descending book and anticipates the closing title.
Secure and perfected ordering makes the book's descent an enacted form of wisdom.
The repeated prevailing force closes what the opening title initiated.
The repeated perfected ordering seals the surah as a coherent disclosed order.

structural_cues: 45:2 and 45:37 repeat the same two roots in the same order at the opening and close.
At 45:2 the pair modifies the source of the book; at 45:37 it follows the attribution of cosmic grandeur.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the exact title-pair repetition and the opening descent of the book; I infer that the repetition forms a deliberate frame that makes the close read back over revelation, while the live alternative is a recurrent formula without strong compositional force.

changed_reading.before: The final titles simply confirm the preceding assertion.
changed_reading.after: The final titles close an opening-to-ending frame: the ordered revelation and the grandeur disclosed throughout it share one signature.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated signs, downward delivery, rain-life, purposeful subjection, and creation in truth turn the heavens-earth pair into a working system of transformations. Grandeur in those domains is dynamic administration that makes order, life, movement, and intelligibility occur.

activation_trace.role: A visible sign makes the paired cosmic domains readable rather than merely extensive.
Delivery downward supplies the directional transfer from the upper domain to the lower.
Earth-life through rain and growth supplies the concrete result of the downward transfer.
Directed subjection supplies purposive control that makes the sea usable.
Stable correspondence with reality supplies the normative order of cosmic creation.
Rightful grandeur gathers the preceding transformations as expressions of one administration.
The upper domain supplies the source side of the administered vertical system.
The lower domain supplies the receptive and manifest side of the system.
Perfected construction supplies the coherence linking descent, life, movement, and signification.

structural_cues: 45:3, 45:13, and 45:22 repeatedly reopen the heavens-earth pair before the focus ayah.
45:5 moves from descent out of heaven to revived earth, while 45:12-13 place sea and both cosmic domains in directed service.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated cosmic pairing and the descent-life-subjection sequence; I infer a causal system in which upper-to-lower transfer displays ordered rule, while a live alternative reads these as parallel sign examples without one integrated mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The heavens and earth are a static measure of how far grandeur extends.
changed_reading.after: They are an administered field in which grandeur becomes visible through directed descent, revivification, service, and stable order.

context_deltas.mechanism: Human self-exaltation appears precisely where audition fails to become reception, and it is recalled near judgment. The final attribution relocates grandeur from the refusing human posture to its rightful possessor, so the focus ayah also functions as a verdict on counterfeit greatness.

activation_trace.role: Physical audition supplies the received evidence that arrogance refuses to let become responsive hearing.
Human self-exaltation supplies the first counterfeit claim to the grandeur later assigned rightly.
The repeated accusation at judgment confirms self-exaltation as the posture under review.
Rightful grandeur supplies the final reassignment that exposes the human version as usurpation.

structural_cues: The ك ب ر root marks human refusal at 45:8 and 45:31 before becoming the focus ayah's central noun.
The focus ayah fronts possession immediately after the judgment scene has named human self-exaltation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated human forms and the final fronted attribution; I infer that the close contrasts borrowed self-inflation with rightful grandeur, while an alternative treats the human vice and divine attribute as related only by general opposition.

changed_reading.before: The focus ayah only praises divine majesty.
changed_reading.after: It also judges the surah's repeated human self-magnification by returning grandeur to its rightful and effective source.

context_deltas.mechanism: The middle sequence distinguishes sound judgment from the bad judgment that equates unlike moral lives. Decisive adjudication, creation in truth, and matched recompense load الحكيم with judicial discrimination: wisdom preserves consequential differences and العزيز can enforce them.

activation_trace.role: Granted judgment supplies an explicit legal-adjudicative register for the focus title.
A decisive ruling supplies the act that resolves contested difference.
Condemned judgment supplies the negative case: wisdom does not flatten morally unlike lives into equality.
Truth fixed against falsehood supplies the stable basis on which distinctions can be judged.
Matching an act with its consequence supplies the output of discriminating judgment.
Prevailing force supplies the ability to execute the distinctions judgment establishes.
Adjudication between people supplies the closing title's judicial edge.

structural_cues: 45:17 places decisive judgment after disagreement, and 45:21 explicitly labels the equalization of unlike lives a bad judgment.
45:22 links creation in truth to the purpose that every self receive according to what it acquired.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies judgment, decisive ruling, truth, and recompense in sequence; I infer that this sequence specializes الحكيم as preserving and enforcing right distinctions, while a live alternative keeps the title primarily about comprehensive knowledge or craftsmanship.

changed_reading.before: الحكيم means generally wise, balancing the force of العزيز.
changed_reading.after: الحكيم is also the discriminating judge who refuses false equivalence, with العزيز naming the power that makes the just distinction effective.

context_deltas.mechanism: Sovereignty over the heavens and earth becomes a courtroom: communities kneel, each is summoned to a binding record, the record gives articulate evidence through preserved copying, and recompense separates rescue from loss. The focus ayah's grandeur is therefore jurisdiction with an evidentiary process, not naked dominance.

activation_trace.role: Sovereignty and rule supply the jurisdictional basis of the ensuing assembly.
Kneeling on the knees supplies the bodily posture of communities placed under judgment.
A written fixation that entails judgment supplies each community's binding docket.
Matched consequence supplies the courtroom's operative verdict.
A sign that speaks for itself supplies evidence rather than unsupported accusation.
Transfer of a book's exact image into another book supplies continuity and preservation of the record.
Attainment of good and rescue supplies one differentiated outcome of the verdict.
Rightful grandeur names the stature of the jurisdiction just displayed.
Prevailing force guarantees that no rival can defeat the verdict.
Adjudication supplies the procedural character of the final wisdom title.

structural_cues: 45:27 states cosmic sovereignty, 45:28 assembles kneeling communities, and 45:29 makes the preserved record testify.
45:30-35 then distribute entry, loss, enclosure, and non-exit before the doxological close.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sovereignty, bodily submission, books, copied evidence, and differentiated outcomes; I infer a single jurisdictional process culminating in the focus titles, while an alternative treats the scenes as eschatological narrative that does not materially specialize the closing attributes.

changed_reading.before: Cosmic grandeur means unrestricted sovereign power.
changed_reading.after: Cosmic grandeur means evidence-backed jurisdiction whose prevailing power executes a reasoned and differentiated judgment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding attribution of praise and threefold lordship is answered by a parallel attribution of grandeur over the same named domains. Praise is the evaluative response to demonstrated rule; grandeur is the rank and scope that response acknowledges.

activation_trace.role: Praise as the opposite of blame supplies the evaluative response to the preceding judgment.
Repeated lordship as ownership and rule supplies the relation joining every named domain to one sovereign.
Rightful grandeur supplies what the parallel second attribution acknowledges after praise.
The upper domain repeats the immediately preceding scope and binds the two doxological lines.
The lower domain repeats the immediately preceding scope and completes the parallelism.

structural_cues: 45:36 and 45:37 use adjacent fronted possession constructions for praise and grandeur.
Heavens and earth recur in the same order, while 45:36 repeats lordship across heavens, earth, and the worlds.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacency, parallel possession syntax, and repeated domains; I infer that praise leads into acknowledged grandeur as a two-step response to the surah, while a live alternative hears two additive but independent doxological statements.

changed_reading.before: The focus ayah begins a detached final assertion after praise has already concluded.
changed_reading.after: It is the second half of a parallel doxology: praise evaluates the displayed rule, and grandeur names the rank that evaluation recognizes.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the packet's alternate و س م mapping inside the focus sky-form and treats a lexical side branch as a cross-domain mechanism. It remains anchored by the explicit split inventory, the focus heavens-earth construction, and 45:5's exact descent-life-sign sequence. Downstream prose should present it as an exploratory resonance, not as the etymology or replacement meaning of السماوات.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus heavens form has an alternate mapped branch in which first rain marks earth with vegetation, while the focus earth has a fertile-growth branch.

activation_trace.role: The first rain leaving a vegetal mark supplies a latent inscription mechanism within the focus sky-form.
Soft fertile ground supplies the receptive surface on which the upper mark becomes growth.
Rightful grandeur supplies the quality made perceptible through the marking transfer.
Delivery downward supplies the arrow from sky to receptive ground.
Rain-caused life and vegetation supply the visible content of the mark.
The visible sign makes the living mark readable as disclosure rather than mere weather.

changed_reading.before: Heavens and earth are two static regions containing grandeur.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the upper realm marks the lower with rain-born life, so grandeur appears as a legible transfer written across the cosmic pair.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it combines materially distant branches: greatness as weight, might as cohesion, and wisdom as a bridle. It remains anchored in all three focus expressions and is activated by 45:12's directed sea-voyage mechanism. Downstream prose should qualify it as a functional analogy for controlled force and must not literalize weight, ground, tack, or bodily restraint as divine attributes.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus sequence الكبرياء العزيز الحكيم contains branches for hard-to-bear weight, cohesive firmness, and the restraining part of a bridle.

activation_trace.role: Difficult weight supplies the scale of force that must be borne and directed.
Firm ground and material cohesion supply strength that holds together under load.
The restraining and directing bridle supplies a material analogy for wisdom governing strength.
Subjection toward a purpose activates the idea that power is made serviceable by direction.
Flowing movement supplies the effect achieved when force is given a course.
A vessel moving through water supplies the concrete system in which held structure and directed force enable passage.

changed_reading.before: Grandeur, might, and wisdom are three adjacent honorific qualities.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, they form a controlled-force system: immense weight, cohesive power, and restraint that directs power into purposive movement.

strongest_changes: The repeated العزيز الحكيم pair turns the focus ayah into the closing half of a revelation frame begun at 45:2.
The repeated human ك ب ر forms make the final attribution of grandeur a verdict against counterfeit self-exaltation.
The heavens-earth pair changes from static extent into an administered field of descent, revivification, subjection, and signs.
The judgment and record sequence specializes الحكيم as judicial differentiation and makes grandeur evidence-backed jurisdiction.
The parallel 45:36-37 syntax makes praise and grandeur two linked responses to the rule displayed by the surah.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah is unusually compressed but context reactivates each part: its final title pair frames the surah, its grandeur root reverses human arrogance, its cosmic pair has dynamic and even marking-based readings, and its might-wisdom pair supports legal, procedural, and materially restrained-force models without requiring them to collapse into one interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: The degree to which the fronted possession construction demands exclusivity rather than emphatic attribution remains open.
The opening-closing title repetition may be a deliberate frame or a less specific recurrence of a standard pair.
The courtroom sequence may semantically specialize the final titles, or it may remain a thematic lead-in without changing their lexical force.
The alternate mapping and material outliers are packet-licensed activations, not claims of direct etymology, and require explicit exploratory qualification.
